summary: Inspected all 23 files in the work unit. The 4 number field definition files (LMFDB_2_0_55_1.lean, LMFDB_2_2_229_1.lean, LMFDB_3_1_1255_1.lean, LMFDB_4_0_10304_1.lean) contain formal number field constructions with minimal polynomials, irreducibility proofs via Brillhart certificates, and axioms for discriminants, Galois properties, class numbers, and CM fields. The 12 proof files (LMFDB_Proof_*.lean) contain explicit irreducibility certificates with concrete parameters for Brillhart's test. The 2 template files (min_poly_*.lean) define number fields and fundamental units with partially sorryed axioms but actual unit proofs. The 4 tactic/widget files (LMFDBUtils.lean, LMFDBWidget.lean, LMFDB_search.lean, tictac.lean) are metaprogramming infrastructure for LMFDB search and Lean code generation; notably LMFDB_search.lean:179-209 also contains a concrete number field definition with proof. All files contain formal Lean declarations; the mathematical files contain core mathematical content (definitions, theorems, axioms), while the tactic files are formalization tooling. Per FILTER-002 and FILTER-025, the default is retain when value is uncertain, and hard exclusion requires a prover-aware check establishing no formal mathematical content — which is not met here.
